title: DIO parser accepts the reserved G/MOP/Prf bit as a canonical control message
description: python/src/lichen/rpl/messages.py:DIO.from_bytes ignores bit 6 of the G/MOP/Prf octet: grounded reads bit7, MOP reads bits5..3 and preference bits2..0, so wire values differing only by reserved bit 0x40 parse to the same DIO and authenticated admission accepts them. DIO.to_bytes always clears that bit, creating parse/reserialize non-canonicality and cross-implementation ambiguity at a signed routing-control boundary. Reject gmop_prf & 0x40 before issuing AuthenticatedDio and add direct/fragmented/vector tests.
